purpose: Prepared independent role-evaluation inputs. Not sent by the demo exporter or host-contract runner; no model evaluation has run.

cases.task: Determine which installation requirement remains supported by the supplied sources.

references.text: The current release requires Node 24.11 within Node 24.
An undated third-party post recommends Node 20.

criteria: Prefer the dated primary release requirement.
Cite both sources and expose the third-party freshness gap.

cases.task: Prepare a task from the report without inventing missing facts.

references.text: Export fails only after restoring an archived project. The reporter supplied no status code or exported file.

criteria: Scope the task to archive/restore/export.
Ask for steps, status and retained file; leave cause unconfirmed.

cases.task: Assess a proposed write after cancellation.

references.text: Job state is cancelled at project revision 7. A late provider response requests a file replacement based on revision 7.

criteria: Reject the late write despite a matching revision.
Retain the terminal cancellation and require explicit new work.

cases.task: Specify failure and recovery tests for a retained draft.

references.text: The first save returns HTTP 429. A later explicit retry returns 200. The draft must remain available until success.

criteria: Assert the visible local error and unchanged draft after 429.
Assert a single successful write and clearing only after 200.

cases.task: Review keyboard recovery when a modal closes.

references.text: A keyboard user opens a project preview, presses Escape, and focus falls to the document body. Navigation must remain visible at 360px.

criteria: Restore focus to the preview launcher without scrolling the document.
Check Escape, keyboard reachability and narrow page containment.

cases.task: Decide whether the current patch is eligible for merge.

references.text: The current patch hash is def. The recorded approval is for abc. Syntax parsing passes for def.

criteria: Refuse merge because approval belongs to another patch.
Do not treat parsing as runtime correctness or a fresh review.

references.text: A latest-40 UI reduced DOM size. Full snapshot bytes are unchanged; changed-snapshot transfer has not been measured on real retained histories.

criteria: Measure transfer before committing to a partial cache.
Retain revision, missing-data and reading-position requirements.

references.text: The request is for project A. The only supplied architecture document belongs to project B.

criteria: Keep project scope explicit and request A's document.
Do not present B's architecture as A's facts.

cases.task: Normalize the supplied status without losing uncertainty.

references.text: An item has status 'possibly-ready'. Allowed states are documented, configured, contract-tested and runtime-verified. No execution receipt exists.

criteria: Preserve the unknown value for review.
Do not upgrade it to runtime-verified without evidence.

references.text: The README calls a temporary directory a secure sandbox. The implementation only launches a Node child process there.

criteria: Remove the unsupported security-boundary claim.
Describe the actually exercised process behavior and unavailable isolation.

references.text: Both browser batches received 926125 bytes. DOM count fell; the author claims network transfer improved by 90 percent.

criteria: Reject the unsupported network reduction.
Distinguish measured DOM work, transfer bytes and noisy startup timings.

cases.task: Prepare a bounded investigation of a stale issue update.

references.text: Relevant entries include Commons app.mjs, projects.mjs, store.mjs and commons-projects.test.mjs. Storage migration files are applied; model inference is prohibited.

criteria: Trace API validation, transaction and focused test first.
Avoid model calls and editing applied migrations.
